# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 17 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QHa (Cave 1), Col. 17 | **Condition:** moderately damaged

---

**17:1** I thank You, O Lord, for You have enlightened my face for Your covenant,

**17:2** and from [...] I seek You, and sure as the dawn You appear to me as perfect light.

**17:3** But they, Your people [...] have led them astray, and spokesmen of falsehood have smoothed their way,

**17:4** so they stumble without understanding. For [...] their deeds are in madness.

**17:5** For I am despised by them, and they do not esteem me

**17:6** when You strengthen Yourself in me. For they have driven me from my land

**17:7** like a bird from its nest, and all my companions and friends

**17:8** have been driven far from me. They regard me as a broken vessel.

**17:9** And they, interpreters of lies and seers of deceit,

**17:10** they have plotted wickedness against me, to exchange Your instruction that You have engraved upon my heart

**17:11** for smooth things to Your people. And they withhold the drink of knowledge from the thirsty

**17:12** and for their thirst give them vinegar to drink, that they may gaze upon

**17:13** their error, behaving madly at their feasts, trapped in their nets.

**17:14** But You, O God, You despise every purpose of Belial,

**17:15** and Your counsel alone stands, and the purpose of Your heart is established forever.

**17:16** And they are pretenders; they plot the schemes of Belial,

**17:17** they seek You with a double heart, and are not established in Your truth.

**17:18** A root bearing poison and wormwood is in their thoughts,

**17:19** and in the stubbornness of their hearts they go about, and they seek You among idols,

**17:20** and the stumbling block of their iniquity they have set before their faces.

**17:21** They have come to seek You from the mouth of lying prophets, seduced by error.

**17:22** And they, with stammering lip and a foreign tongue,

**17:23** they speak to Your people, to make foolish all their works by deceit.

**17:24** For they have not chosen the way of Your heart, and they have not listened to Your word;

**17:25** for they said of the vision of knowledge: It is not established! And of the way of Your heart: It is not that!

**17:26** But You, O God, You will answer them, judging them in Your might

**17:27** according to their idols and the multitude of their transgressions,

**17:28** so that they are caught in their own schemes, they who have turned aside from Your covenant.

**17:29** And You shall cut off in judgment all men of deceit, and seers of error shall be found no more.

**17:30** For there is no foolishness in all Your works, and no deceit in the purpose of Your heart.

**17:31** But those who are according to Your pleasure shall stand before You forever,

**17:32** and those who walk in the way of Your heart shall be established for eternity.

**17:33** And as for me, when I hold fast to You, I rise and stand upright against those who despise me,

**17:34** and my hand is against all who mock me. For they do not esteem me

**17:35** even when You show Your might through me. For You have appeared to me in Your strength at the break of dawn,

**17:36** and You have not covered my face with shame [...] who seek You in the council of community [...]

**17:37** [...] standing before You [...] forever.

---
*EMET notes: Column 17 is a sharp polemic against false teachers and lying prophets. "Interpreters of lies" (melitzei kazav) and "seers of deceit" (choze remiyah) are Qumran designations for opponents. The "root bearing poison and wormwood" (line 18) echoes Deuteronomy 29:17. "Smooth things" (chalaqot) alludes to the opponents called "Seekers of Smooth Things."*
